gumtree_entries.description: DELETED o2: Creates the BloomFilter implementation we are testing. @param shape the shape of the filter. @param extractor A BitMap extractor to build the filter with. @retu
UPDATED o8 -> i8: Test different lengths
ADDED i1: Shape with k=17 hash functions and m=72 bits, used across all test scenarios.
ADDED i2: bf1 encodes FROM1 (indices 1..17); bf2 encodes both FROM1 and FROM11 (indices 1..27), making bf2 a strict superset of bf1.
ADDED i3: A filter always contains itself.
ADDED i4: bf2 is a superset of bf1: bf1 cannot contain bf2, but bf2 can contain bf1.
ADDED i5: contains(Hasher): hasher(1,1) maps entirely within bf2; hasher(1,3) produces indices that fall outside the bits set in bf2.
ADDED i6: contains(IndexExtractor): same containment checks expressed as index extractors.
ADDED i7: contains(BitMapExtractor): same containment checks expressed as bit map extractors.
ADDED i9: bf4 populates a wider bit range (1..28) in the smaller shape. bf1 does not cover all of bf4's bits, but bf4 covers all of bf1's bits.
